Heatmap - subject variability of highly subject specific functional genes

library(Seurat)
library(pheatmap)
library(stringr)
set.seed(4)

nrchd_gene_df<-read.csv("supp_tables_S10.csv") 
enrichment_df<-readRDS("NICA_batch1to4_age_corrected_normalized_subject_enriched.rds")
vpars<-readRDS("NICA_batch1to4_age_corrected_normalized_vpars_obj.rds")
inh<-read.csv("inheritability_data_pvals.csv")
inh777<-read.csv("inheritability_data_777.csv")
inh777<-inh777$X
inh777<-inh[which(inh$probe.id %in% inh777),]$gene.symbol


genesetl<-list()
for (i in seq(1,nrow(nrchd_gene_df))){
  gset<-unlist(str_split(nrchd_gene_df$leadingEdge[i]," "))
  genesetl[[paste(str_split(nrchd_gene_df$pathway[i],"_")[[1]][2:3],collapse="_")]]<-gset[which(!startsWith(gset,"HLA-"))]
}

ledge<-unique(unlist(enrichment_df$leadingEdge))
vpars_h<-vpars[c("subject_variance_explained","celltype","gene")]
vpars_h<-vpars_h[which(!(vpars_h$celltype %in% c("ILC","doublets"))),]
vpars_h<-reshape(vpars_h, idvar = "gene", timevar = "celltype", direction = "wide")
vpars_h[is.na(vpars_h)]<-0
genes<-vpars_h$gene
vpars_h<-vpars_h[which(colnames(vpars_h)!="gene")]
vpars_h<-sapply(vpars_h, as.numeric)
row.names(vpars_h)<-genes
colnames(vpars_h)<-as.vector(sapply(colnames(vpars_h),function(x){str_split_i(x,"\\.",2)}))
vpars_h<-vpars_h[which(rownames(vpars_h) %in% unlist(ledge)),]


ledge_list<-list()
for (pway in unique(enrichment_df$pathway)){ 
  ledge<-unique(unlist(enrichment_df[which(enrichment_df$pathway==pway),]$leadingEdge))
  ledge_list[[pway]]<-ledge
}

p_annot_l<-list()
for (p in names(ledge_list)){
    p_annot<-as.numeric(rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[[p]])
    p_annot_l[[p]]<-p_annot
}
p_annot_l<-as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,p_annot_l))
rownames(p_annot_l)<-rownames(vpars_h)

p_annot<-as.numeric(rownames(vpars_h) %in% inh777)
p_annot_l$highly_inheritable_genes<-p_annot

p<-pheatmap(t(vpars_h), scale="none", clustering_distance_cols="correlation", cutree_cols = 5, silent = T)
p_annot_l$clusterid<-cutree(p$tree_col, k = 5)[rownames(vpars_h)]
p_annot_l<-p_annot_l[c("highly_inheritable_genes","clusterid")]

pheatmap(t(vpars_h), scale="none", main="all", fontsize_row=12, fontsize=6, fontsize_col = 1, legend = FALSE, annotation_legend = FALSE ,annotation_col=p_annot_l, clustering_distance_cols="correlation", cutree_cols = 5)

#visualize variance partitioning for top15 genes per main cluster

#var_b (Bcell dominated cluster)
var_b<-vpars[row.names(p_annot_l[which(p_annot_l$clusterid==3),]),]
var_b<-head(var_b[order(var_b$subject_variance_explained, decreasing = T),],15)
var_b<-melt(var_b[c("subject_variance_explained","gender_variance_explained","residual_variance_explained","age_variance_explained","batch","gene")])
Using gene as id variables
ggplot(data=var_b,aes(y=gene,x=value,fill=variable))+geom_bar(stat='identity')+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(head(var_b,15)$gene)) + theme_bw() + labs(title="Bcells")


#var_t (Tcell dominated cluster)
var_t<-vpars[row.names(p_annot_l[which(p_annot_l$clusterid==1),]),]
var_t<-head(var_t[order(var_t$subject_variance_explained, decreasing = T),],15)
var_t<-melt(var_t[c("subject_variance_explained","gender_variance_explained","residual_variance_explained","age_variance_explained","batch","gene")])
Using gene as id variables
ggplot(data=var_t,aes(y=gene,x=value,fill=variable))+geom_bar(stat='identity')+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(head(var_t,15)$gene)) + theme_bw() + labs(title="Tcells")


#var_n (NKcell dominated cluster)
var_n<-vpars[row.names(p_annot_l[which(p_annot_l$clusterid==2),]),]
var_n<-head(var_n[order(var_n$subject_variance_explained, decreasing = T),],15)
var_n<-melt(var_n[c("subject_variance_explained","gender_variance_explained","residual_variance_explained","age_variance_explained","batch","gene")])
Using gene as id variables
ggplot(data=var_n,aes(y=gene,x=value,fill=variable))+geom_bar(stat='identity')+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(head(var_n,15)$gene)) + theme_bw() + labs(title="NKcells")


#var_m (Monocyte dominated cluster)
var_m<-vpars[row.names(p_annot_l[which(p_annot_l$clusterid==4 | p_annot_l$clusterid==5),]),]
var_m<-head(var_m[order(var_m$subject_variance_explained, decreasing = T),],15)
var_m<-melt(var_m[c("subject_variance_explained","gender_variance_explained","residual_variance_explained","age_variance_explained","batch","gene")])
Using gene as id variables
ggplot(data=var_m,aes(y=gene,x=value,fill=variable))+geom_bar(stat='identity')+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(head(var_m,15)$gene)) + theme_bw() + labs(title="Monocytes")
